# S1 software tests (generated by `python -m sw.test_s1`)

1. MIT frames: pack → unpack round trip within one quantisation step; special frames.
2. Safety supervisor against the bench twin with injected faults: a wild policy (random targets far outside the
   limits and the workspace), a stalled loop (watchdog), an e-stop, an over-temperature report. The arm must never leave
   its limits or the workspace box, and every fault must stop it within one cycle.
3. Virtual-bus round trip for the DM-J4310 driver.
4. People-near mode (D25 / R17): the shoulder-roll soft limit while a person is close. A random policy with the mode on
   never puts the roll below the limit; switching the mode on with the arm inside the restricted zone walks it out
   slowly (no stop, heartbeat kept); the trigger turns on within 1.5 m, fails safe without perception, and releases
   with hysteresis.
5. Collision detection (D23 / R17, sw/collision.py): the bench twin as the plant with the 20 lb payload in hand and model
   errors; no false trips over random motion, every injected contact trips within 20 ms, then a compliant hold.
6. Battery-current budget (W8a, sw/power.py): the model's constants match the electrical track; a random high-torque
   policy (peak torque allowed) never predicts more than 70 A of battery current; under sustained high-speed high-torque
   demand the 30 s mean stays ≤ 28 A and settles just under it, then recovers when the demand stops; normal motion on
   the bench twin gets exactly the same commands as with the budget off; the R2d basket carry (both arms, 4.54 kg each,
   120 s) is neither capped nor derated; nothing stops the arm; BMS over-current / under-voltage flags latch a fault.
7. SW-T1 person within reach (A10 v2, rnd/tip.py), the same people-near mode as 4.: a random arm policy and random base
   commands with the mode on never put the hand outside the SW-T1 box or the base over 0.1 m/s / 0.1 m/s²; with load mode
   on too the box is the intersection and the lower limits win; > 2.5 kg with a person near stops the base; entering with
   the hand outside the box walks it in (the box distance never grows, no stop); a person appearing during a fast transit
   brakes the base at the transit's accel limit down to 0.1 m/s, then holds the SW-T1 limits.
8. SW-T2 caster lock + SW-T4 threshold speed: locked by default; released only on request for a threshold crossing
   (speed ≤ 0.12 m/s) or unloaded transit; refused / forced locked with a person near, a fault or too much payload;
   re-lock, every stop and every 0.3 m of locked travel give a 0.1 s re-seat pulse; accel ≤ 0.5 m/s² while not locked.
8b. SW-T2 caster lock at speed (W15b): a fault, a person approaching or near, a payload past the transit limit or the
   planner's lock at 0.8 m/s is deferred (casters released, `casters_locked()` False) until the base is ≤ min(V_CASTER_LOCK
   0.25, the SW-T8 cap) = 0.20 m/s unloaded (the measured speed if odometry lags; a timeout if it never reports the
   slowdown); threshold mode locks at once; the unloaded locked-travel cap (0.20 m/s since SW-T8; 0.25 in W16a) passes the
   W15b snag model, 0.30 m/s does not.
8c. SW-T8 payload-dependent locked cap (W17d, docs/rnd/tip.md *Snag at the locked cap*): `caster_locked_v_for` at the band
   edges (6.0 / 6.01 / 10.0 / 10.01 kg → 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.15 / 0 m/s), applied while locked, locking and pulsing and held with
   0.8 m/s commanded; a payload step into a heavier band while moving brakes to the new cap at the limit in force; a
   deferred lock engages at the lower speed of the heavier band; no travel above 10 kg; threshold mode stays at 0.12 m/s.
12. Base stop category 1 (sw/safety.py 17., tip.md *E-stop / snag braking*): BASE_STOP_DECEL is read from tip.json's 30 mm
   column (floored to 0.01 m/s², with a lower fallback for a missing or malformed file) and sits under tip.md's column
   for each payload; an e-stop or a watchdog fault ramps the base to 0 at min(the limit in force, the table), never
   harder; the arm heartbeat drops at once while the base channel keeps its heartbeat until the ramp ends, then base
   torque goes off; wheels still turning hold it on until stopped, but never past the ramp + BASE_STOP_GRACE; a
   collision hold ramps the base and keeps it powered; a stationary base loses torque at once; reset re-enables it.
13. Twin IK determinism (rnd/twin.py): a target solved, then another, then the first again, and on a fresh solver gives
   identical solutions (the random restarts are seeded per call from the call's inputs, not from one shared RNG).

- MIT pack/unpack: worst error 0.50 quantisation steps over 2000 random commands ✅
- DM-J4310 driver on a virtual bus: enable, command, feedback ✅
- Load mode (R2d): with 4.54 kg in hand the hand stays in the load box over 800 random cycles (robot default: ≤ 0.45 m out, ≤ 0.80 m up), braking capped at 0.3 m/s², load heading checked against the wheel axes ✅. Safety supervisor v2 vs a random policy (random targets, gains 0–200 N·m/rad, τ_ff σ 40 N·m): 3000 cycles, 0 limit/workspace violations, **0 cycles where the drive torque kp·e + kd·ė + τ_ff exceeds the rated torque**. NaN feedback, stale feedback, watchdog, e-stop (reset refused while pressed), over-temperature, motor error, overspeed and tracking error each stop on the next cycle and stay latched ✅ (overrides: {'joint limit clamp': 3775, 'velocity clamp': 3800, 'gain cap': 3000, 'torque bound': 3000, 'feedback missing, NaN or stale': 2, 'base stop ramp': 1, 'watchdog': 1, 'e-stop': 1, 'over temperature or bad temperature reading': 1, 'motor error flag': 1, 'measured speed over limit': 1, 'tracking error': 1})
- People-near mode (D25/R17): roll soft limit +5° (target bound +8° with the margin). Switched on with the roll at −10° and the policy still asking for −15°: walked out in 2.08 s at ≤ 0.2 rad/s, no stop, heartbeat kept; then a random policy for 3000 cycles: **0 cycles with the roll below the limit**; leaving the mode restores the full range; the trigger (≤ 1.5 m on, > 1.8 m for 2 s off, no or stale perception = on) ✅ (overrides: {'people-near on': 1, 'people-near clamp': 160})
- Collision detection (D23/R17, momentum observer vs the twin's model torque, 4.54 kg payload, model errors: payload +5 %, COM 10 mm, friction, Kt ±4 %, current noise 1 %): **0 false trips over 3 × 3000 cycles** of random motion (peak residual 83% of the threshold); a 60 N forearm push trips in 10–12 ms and a joint torque of twice the trip level (3.9–10.1 N·m) on each monitored joint in 12–18 ms (limit 20 ms); after a trip the arm holds compliantly (no stop, drift < 0.3 rad over 0.5 s) until reset ✅
- Battery budget (W8a; battery current = electrical input power / V_bus per joint: k·R·I_ph² + τ·ω/η, braking offsets only its own copper loss, + idle + 9.9 A for the rest of the robot): a random high-torque policy (peak torque allowed, 1–3.5 rad/s, bus sagged to 18 V) asks for up to 86 A; **0 of 4000 cycles predict over 70 A** (max 70.0 A, capped in 867 cycles, feed-forward then gains). Sustained high-speed high-torque demand (1.5–3.5 rad/s, 2 × peak torque along the motion) for 100 s: 70 A allowed for the first 7.3 s (burst), then **the 30 s mean never exceeds 28 A** (max 27.94 A; 26.7–27.9 A after 60 s, torque-limit factor k ≈ 1.00); demand stopped: back to 10.2 A and the full 70 A ceiling in 40 s. Normal motion on the bench twin (32 s, carry pose, no payload): 10.5 A mean / 10.9 A max, 30 s mean 10.5 A, **commands identical to the budget off** (0 caps, 0 derates). No stop and the heartbeat kept in every run; BMS over-current and under-voltage latch a fault; with the BMS reading 45 A the arm still never predicts over 70 A and keeps running. **R2d basket carry, both arms with 4.54 kg each held 120 s:** 8.2 A per arm (max 8.9 A), robot 26.2 A, 30 s mean ≤ 26.3 A: no cap, no derate ✅ (overrides: {'BMS over-current or under-voltage': 2, 'current cap': 1935, 'power derate': 2000})
- SW-T1 person within reach (one people-near mode; `set_person_near` = `set_people_near`): robot-frame box x 0.10–0.35 m, z 0.20–0.60 m (LOAD_WS ∩ x ≤ 0.35, z ≤ 0.60). Random arm policy + random base commands with the mode on: 3000 cycles, **0 cycles with the hand outside the box, 0 over 0.1 m/s or 0.1 m/s²**, every caster release refused; with load mode on too (2 kg): 1500 cycles, 0 outside the intersection of the two boxes, accel cap 0.1 m/s²; 4.54 kg with a person near → base held at 0 m/s. Entering with the hand 30 mm outside and the roll at −10°: walked in in 0.70 s, box distance never grew, roll walked out at ≤ 0.20 rad/s (D25 0.2), no stop. Person appearing at 0.8 m/s (casters released for transit): lock deferred to 0.20 m/s, braked at 0.5 m/s² to 0.1 m/s in 1.40 s, then held to the SW-T1 limits ✅
- SW-T2 caster lock: locked by default (solenoid off), 0.2 m/s while locked; threshold release → ≤ 0.12 m/s (SW-T4 `threshold_speed()`), ≤ 0.5 m/s² (0.3 loaded); transit release only unloaded (0.8 m/s), ended at once by a payload; releases refused and ended by a person near, a fault (base → 0 m/s) or > 2.5 kg; re-lock, stopping and every 0.3 m locked (1 pulses over 0.58 m) give a 100 ms re-seat pulse ✅ (overrides: {'caster release (threshold)': 2, 'base speed clamp': 5300, 'base accel clamp': 1483, 'caster re-seat pulse': 4, 'caster release refused': 6, 'caster release (transit)': 2, 'caster forced lock': 3, 'base stop ramp': 1, 'caster lock deferred': 1})
- SW-T2 caster lock at speed (W15b): a forced lock or a planner lock above min(V_CASTER_LOCK = 0.25, the SW-T8 cap) = 0.2 m/s unloaded is deferred ("caster lock deferred"; casters released, solenoids on, `casters_locked()` False) while the base brakes, then engages with no re-seat pulse: e-stop at 0.8 m/s: deferred, lock at 1.20 s / 0.200 m/s (ramp 0.50 m/s²); odometry 0.2 s late: lock at 1.40 s, measured 0.200 m/s; odometry stuck at 0.8 m/s: lock at 1.50 s (timeout, counted); person approaching at 0.8 m/s: lock at 1.20 s / 0.200 m/s, then 0.1 m/s; threshold mode at 0.12 m/s: e-stop / person / payload lock at once; unloaded locked cap 0.2 m/s (held at 0.200 with 0.8 commanded): snag force ≤ 240 N per foot vs 440 N allowed (0.30 m/s: 539 N ❌); the R2d basket (9.07 kg) at its SW-T8 cap 0.15 m/s uses 41% of the tip energy in W15b's tuck-pose chord model (allowed 25%; superseded by tip.md's W17 real-pose polygon-pivot rows, which pass at that cap) ✅
- SW-T8 payload-dependent locked cap (`caster_locked_v_for`: ≤ 6 kg 0.20, ≤ 10 kg 0.15, above 0 m/s; threshold mode 0.12 m/s): cap at 6.0 / 6.01 / 10.0 / 10.01 kg: 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.15 / 0.00 m/s held; 4 → 9.07 kg at 0.20 m/s: braked at 0.30 m/s² to 0.15 in 0.17 s; 0 → 8 kg at 0.20 m/s: braked at 0.52 m/s² to 0.15 in 0.10 s; 9.07 → 10.01 kg at 0.15 m/s: braked at 0.30 m/s² to 0.00 in 0.50 s; 0 → 12 kg at 0.20 m/s: braked at 0.39 m/s² to 0.00 in 0.51 s; deferred lock with 8 kg: engaged at 0.150 m/s, 1.30 s after the step (W16a: 0.25 m/s); > 10 kg: base held at 0 m/s (area clear), releases refused ✅
- People-near hand-speed cap (R17 140 N, rnd/hand_speed.py): V_HAND_PN ((0.0, 0.345), (1.0, 0.21), (2.5, 0.16), (4.535, 0.14)) (payload kg, m/s) minus the base speed, joint slew ≤ 0.75 rad/s. Random policy on the bench twin with 0 / 1 / 2.5 / 4.54 kg: 6000 cycles, **worst hand speed 1.000 × the cap, worst joint rate 0.75 rad/s**; at 0.1 m/s of base speed the cap drops by 0.1; without an fk the bound Σ|Δq|·lever holds over 1000 cycles; off with nobody near ✅
- SW-T6 person approaching (≤ 3.5 m, off beyond 4.0 m): PERSON_WS box, casters locked (at ≤ 0.20 m/s, SW-T8), base braked from 0.8 m/s at the transit's 0.5 m/s² to 0.1 m/s in 1.40 s, releases refused, no D25 roll bound; people-near on top and off again keeps it. SW-T7: > 2.5 kg moves only with `set_area_clear(True)` and nobody approaching (default: held at 0 m/s) ✅
- Roll latch (O2, PIP_ROLL_GUARD='none': off by default): solenoid on only healthy + nobody near; without a switch the roll stays ≥ the +5° bound (+3° margin) for 50 ms, with one until it confirms; a person near or an e-stop drops the pin at once; the bound never pulls the arm up; roll torque 16.0 ≤ 16.0 N·m while the pin may be in ✅
- Base stop category 1: BASE_STOP_DECEL read from docs/rnd/tip.json's 30 mm column, floored to 0.01 (fallback 1.00 / 1.30 / 0.45 when the file is missing or malformed, also under the column) and ≤ tip.md's column (≤ 1 kg 1.17, 2.5 kg 1.50, basket 0.52 m/s²; tips at 1.67 / 2.04 / 1.01); an e-stop or watchdog fault ramps at min(limit in force, table): 0 kg at 0.8 m/s → 0.50 m/s², 0 in 1.60 s / 0.64 m; 0 kg at 0.2 m/s → 1.00 m/s², 0 in 0.20 s / 0.02 m; 2.5 kg at 0.2 m/s → 0.30 m/s², 0 in 0.67 s / 0.07 m; 9.07 kg at 0.15 m/s → 0.30 m/s², 0 in 0.50 s / 0.04 m; the arm heartbeat drops at once, the base channel's stays up for the ramp, then base torque off (wheels still turning hold it until < 0.01 m/s, at most ramp + 0.3 s); a collision hold keeps the base powered at 0; a stationary base loses torque at once ✅
- Twin IK (rnd/twin.py Reacher / BiReacher): restarts seeded per call from the inputs (call_rng); target A solved, then B, then A again and on a fresh solver: 2 identical solutions each time (0.4 s) ✅
